data.one_liner: Multi-platform ICMP ping utility for Dart and Flutter with live statistics.
data.what_it_does: Performs ICMP network pings across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Exposes live round-trip statistics and packet-loss summaries through a reactive stream.
use_when: You need to check network connectivity or host reachability in a Dart or Flutter application.
You want live latency statistics and packet-loss summaries during network diagnostics.
avoid_when: You only need standard HTTP health checks rather than low-level ICMP ping packets.
strengths: Supports all major platforms including native iOS via Swift and FFI
Provides real-time round-trip statistics and packet-loss summaries
Allows selecting specific network interfaces or IP versions (IPv4/IPv6)
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configurations like iOS build hooks or macOS App Sandbox network entitlements
ICMP operations may be restricted by device firewalls or OS network permissions
data.setup_notes: iOS uses a bundled Swift ICMP engine compiled via build hooks requiring the 10.x SDK floor. macOS release builds with app sandbox require network client and server entitlements.
